messages:
Alex (Docs): Hey team — opened a tiny PR to tidy up the audit export sample rows and the wording around tenant identifiers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
Miriam (Security): skimmed — main thing is don't imply we store tenant PII in audit rows. Suggest 'pseudonymized tenant identifier' not 'tenant email' or 'clear tenant id'.
Alex (Docs): good call. Naomi can you confirm legal-safe wording for SOC2 docs? We want to say 'tenant identifier (pseudonymized)' vs 'tenant id'
Naomi (Legal): yes. Use 'tenant identifier (non-reversible pseudonym)'. Also add a note about retention TTL and legal holds: 'retention periods apply unless subject to legal hold.'
Kevin (Eng): small SDK snippet update needed — current py example uses legacy export v1. Quick patch suggestion below.
Kevin (Eng): ```python
# new export example (py)
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="${{REDWOOD_KEY}}")
for row in client.export_rows(scope="tenant", tenant_identifier="pseud-123", format="jsonl"):
    print(row)
```
Alex (Docs): thanks. Can we also include a short bash curl example for customers who don't use SDKs?
Kevin (Eng): sure, add this: 
Kevin (Eng): ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/audit/exports?scope=tenant&tenant_id=pseud-123" \
 -o export.jsonl
```
DocsBot: CI passed for docs PR #412 :white_check_mark:
Miriam (Security): tiny nit — add explicit note that exported audit rows exclude raw request body when it contains sensitive fields; link to redaction section: /docs/security/log-redaction
Alex (Docs): I'll add those two notes and push a small commit. any objections to wording? :eyes:
Naomi (Legal): wording OK from legal. prefer 'non-reversible pseudonym' vs 'pseudonymized' in one spot — pick one and be consistent.
Alex (Docs): I'll standardize to 'non-reversible pseudonym' across the snippet and description. Planning to merge in ~2h unless more feedback.
Kevin (Eng): lgtm
Miriam (Security): lgtm
Naomi (Legal): lgtm
Alex (Docs): thanks all — merging after CI re-run.
